name: truemain-web
//browserslist: Kept modern enough that oklch/color-mix stay native (no rgb downlevel) — the `surface` material and the whole token layer are built on them. The Firefox target additionally makes Lightning CSS keep the unprefixed `backdrop-filter`: without it the blur collapses to `-webkit-` only, which Firefox never supported, and the panel renders flat. That mattered app-wide when every card was glass; since #1060 it only affects the home hero, but the target costs nothing to keep and the failure is silent.
